editorial: When a shimmering backyard pool becomes a trap, you’re forced to question what hides beneath. Night Swim, a psychological horror, defies ordinary family drama by turning a domestic setting into a labyrinth of dread. The film’s most striking feature is its uncanny soundscape, where the water’s surface hums a dissonant lullaby that creeps into every frame. Even the quietest scenes drench you in tension, proving that fear isn’t always shouted. If you crave horror that lingers like a phantom wave, Night Swim will grip you from the first splash to the final impossible plunge.
targetAudience: Ideal for viewers who crave horror that stays with you long after the credits roll.
